Customs Says That They Are Monitoring The Web For Marijuana Sales

(Marijuananews note: Notice that there is not any mention of seeds -- nor of importing, even though that is supposedly Customs' jurisdiction.

This article from The ABC NewsWire on Yahoo is the only mention of this that I have seen.)

October 22, 1999

Customs Monitor Online Pot Sales - (SEATTLE)

US Customs officials say they are monitoring the Internet for illegal shipments of marijuana. Drug Enforcement Administration agents recently shut down the Arizona web site of 47-year-old Michael Arono, who was offering what he called medical marijuana to patients. Washington's medical marijuana law has been on the books for just under one year. (Marijuananews note: This was the Arizona Company Medical site.)
